calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 8

SELECT tier, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as active_members
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date <= '2025-12-21'
  AND valid_from <= '2025-12-21'
  AND '2025-12-21' <= valid_to
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_active
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date <= '2025-12-21'
  AND valid_from <= '2025-12-21'
  AND '2025-12-21' <= valid_to

SELECT COUNT(*) as null_join_dates
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date IS NULL

SELECT MIN(join_date) as earliest_join, MAX(join_date) as latest_join
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date <= '2025-12-21'

SELECT DISTINCT tier
FROM dim_member
ORDER BY tier
